The S-shaped glacial lake has an area of 18.88 km2 (7.29 sq mi) and a maximum depth of 31.8 metres (104 feet). The Swięcek and Konopka rivers flow into the lake, while the Pisa River flows out of it. The largest town on the lake is Pisz.
